description: This file defines the Cart class in the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically within the checkout model. It includes methods for retrieving products in the cart and calculating totals, integrating with other system components such as language, tax, and extensions.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents the shopping cart in the checkout process, providing methods to retrieve products and calculate totals.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about products in the cart, including images, options, and subscription data.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Calculates the total amounts, taxes, and applies extensions to modify totals.
